title: runCli
responsibility: Runs the shared executable CLI lifecycle: configures output, warns about stale builds, lazily loads and parses the command, maps expected CLI failures to exit status, and records eligible activity in cleanup.

inputs.name: runCli.entry
inputs.description: Executable entry path passed to the stale-build check for warning generation.

outputs.name: runCli
outputs.description: Completes after command parsing and final analytics/activity hooks; command failures set process.exitCode, and unexpected failures are rethrown.

errors.name: Unexpected command or finalization failure
errors.description: Unexpected command, analytics, or activity-hook failures are rethrown after the finalization attempt.
